name: Purgatory Cafe
source:
An average cat was bestowed with the powers of the dead. In order to get his memories back, he must reap all the souls in the mortal realm. If that wasn't enough for him, he must balance taking souls with taking orders at a cafe.

[From [url=https://latenightdraw.itch.io/purgatory-cafe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一只普通的猫被赋予了死者的力量。为了恢复记忆，他必须收割凡间的所有灵魂。如果这对他来说还不够，他必须在夺取灵魂和在咖啡馆接受订单之间取得平衡。

[来自[url=https://latenightdraw.itch.io/purgatory-cafe]Itch.io[/url]]
